title: Worker notices: one per turn, only when the worker has no background work left

comments.body: Note from main-dashboard: build on #258 (auto-close) and #265 (notices held while main is mid-turn); read their code first. The `pane report <id>` verb belongs to this card. Card 787d9a9a (pane dispatch/finish, pr land) runs after this one, so keep the pane command's verb table easy to extend. Do not bump the version.
